hooks.command: bash -c 'command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; inp=$(cat); if [ -z "$inp" ]; then inp="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"; fi; path=$(printf "%s" "$inp" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty" | tr -d "\r" | tr "\134" "/"); if printf "%s" "$path" | grep -qE "(^|/)(dist|build|[.]next|node_modules|coverage|target|vendor)/"; then echo "Blocked: edit to a generated directory ($path)" >&2; exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; inp=$(cat); if [ -z "$inp" ]; then inp="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"; fi; cmd=$(printf "%s" "$inp" | jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty" | tr -d "\r"); case "$(uname -s)" in MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) n=$(printf "%s" "$cmd" | wc -c | tr -d " "); if [ "$n" -gt 6500 ]; then echo "Blocked: a ${n}-byte command - on a Windows/Git-Bash host the Bash transport corrupts a command past a fixed offset near 7.5 KB (measured): write the payload to a file (Write tool) and run it by path, or split the call" >&2; exit 2; fi;; esac; if printf "%s" "$cmd" | grep -qE "(^|[;&|([:space:]])cat[[:space:]][^|;&]*>>?[[:space:]]*[^&[:space:]][^|;&]*[^<]<<[^<]|(^|[;&|([:space:]])cat([[:space:]][^|;&]*)?[^<]<<[^<][^|;&]*>>?[[:space:]]*[^&[:space:]]|[^<]<<[^<][^|]*[|][[:space:]]*tee[[:space:]]|(^|[;&|([:space:]])tee([[:space:]][^|;&]*)?[^<]<<[^<]"; then echo "Blocked: a cat/tee heredoc with a file target - documents go through the Write tool; a script goes to a scratchpad file run by path" >&2; exit 2; fi'
bash -c 'command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; f=$(cat | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty" | tr -d "\r"); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in *.rs) rustfmt "$f" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac'
